name: REST API for a Todo List
description: Build a Python REST API for a todo list with the following requirements:
prompt:
Build a Python REST API for a todo list using only the standard library (no Flask, no FastAPI, no external dependencies). Requirements:

1. CRUD operations: create, read, update, delete todos
2. Each todo has: id (auto-generated), title, description, completed (boolean), created_at
3. Data stored in a local JSON file (todos.json)
4. Proper HTTP status codes (200, 201, 404, 400)
5. A single file: todo_api.py
6. Must run with: python todo_api.py
7. Must include a test script: test_todo_api.py that exercises all endpoints

Deliver exactly two files: todo_api.py and test_todo_api.py. Nothing else.
acceptance_criteria: todo_api.py runs without errors on python3
